_doc: Phase 1A-beta cube iteration rounds registry. Each round is one full cube re-run. Append entries; never delete. Loaded by scripts/build_dashboard_phase_1a.py and surfaced in Tabs 17 (Iteration Rounds) + 18 (Cell Cube Comparison).

rounds.infra: AWS spot - prior orchestrator config (1 OD + 1 spot, pre Batch 424)
objectives: First full Phase 1A-beta cube run with all 4 legacy gates OFF (--no-portfolio-cap / --no-dd-halt / --no-regime-affinity / --no-event-suppression). Establish baseline.
Validate 185-strategy x 25-exit cube replay produces sensible trade_log + trade_exit_detail.
Surface initial quiet-bucket counts so the next iteration knows where to focus.
changes_from_prior: Vs. Phase 1A baseline (R1 / output_v2): turned OFF all 4 legacy gates so the cube reflects pure strategy + exit edge, not the deployment-gate filter.
findings: 29,159 trades over 4.3-year window with 1,531 unique tickers traded.
Only 100 of 185 strategies fired; 85 quiet. The 6-31-48 bucket split (PRODUCER / COMPOUND / SKIPPED) became the optimization roadmap.
L2 contains 100 cells (4,625 theoretical ceiling per regime). Initially assumed n < 5 floor was the limit; subsequently shown to be degenerate-cell filtering (Batch 442) - but R3 disproved that.
All 6 PRODUCER_LAYER_ZERO_LIKELY strategies were SMC variants - producer-side silent failure investigation triggered.
1A-alpha gate evaluation: best OOS Sharpe 0.419 (walk_forward_batch414_cells.json). Gate LOCKED.

rounds.label: Shape A cube re-run (Batches 414+415+416+421 active)
rounds.infra: AWS spot - Shape A: 3 x c7a.8xlarge spot, ~$9.30, ~5h wall-time (Batch 424 orchestrator slot logic for new 96 vCPU spot quota)
objectives: Validate Batch 415 signals_at_entry enrichment (ticker / strategy_name / category) - fixes pre-existing bugs in exit_earnings_blackout (returned no_earnings_known always) and exit_class_time_stop (defaulted to momentum always).
Surface SMC silent-failure root cause via Batch 416 rate-limited diagnostic logging at 3 producer call sites (classification_change / institutional_signal / smc_ict).
Re-evaluate 1A-alpha gate. Currently LOCKED at best OOS Sharpe 0.419. If any strategy passes >= 0.7 OOS in >= 1 regime, gate opens and Phase 1B-alpha $300 Haiku budget becomes eligible.
Validate Batch 421 PEAD lru_cache (~11% engine speedup; load_quarterly_eps reads each ticker's parquet once instead of once-per-day).
Refresh quiet-bucket lists. Hypothesis: SKIPPED should drop significantly because --no-portfolio-cap + --no-event-suppression were the main blockers.
Refresh STRATEGY_REGIME_AFFINITY (Batches 417+418) - 14 new + 15 override entries derived from R2 cube cell stats. Validate they still hold under fresh data.
changes_from_prior: Batch 414: 9 STRATEGY_EXIT_OVERRIDE entries to breakeven_plus_trail for cube-empirical winners.
Batch 415: signals_at_entry dict enrichment in run_exit_comparison - adds ticker, strategy_name, category before each exit_fn call.
Batch 416: silent-producer logging - replaces try/except: pass with _log_silent_producer_failure / _log_silent_producer_empty rate-limited helpers at 3 producer sites.
Batch 424: AWS orchestrator slot logic (binary -> integer counters; --spot-slots 3 --od-slots 0 for full 96 vCPU spot quota Shape A topology).
findings: Trades 29,159 -> 29,360 (+201, +0.7%). Modest increase, consistent with Batch 415 fixing degenerate exit replays.

Buckets barely moved: PRODUCER 6 (unchanged), COMPOUND 31 (unchanged), SKIPPED 48 -> 47 (-1). The cap/event gates being off should have dropped SKIPPED a lot more; staying at 47 means the remaining cause is structural (liquidity floor / tier-too-low).

L2 cell count stayed at 100 despite Batches 414/415/416 active. The Batch 442 prediction (degenerate-cell filtering would lift count) was WRONG. Some other filter mechanic is at play; needs investigation.
However: composition turned over substantially - 32 cells are NEW and 32 retired vs R2. Total stayed same; identity changed.

Sharpe deltas: 13 cells improved, 36 regressed. Most regressed are small-sample mean-reversion (halloween_seasonal_long Sharpe 28.31 -> 2.95 as n 5 -> 10; inside_bar_breakout 10.91 -> 5.01 as n 28 -> 37). Verdict upgrades: 1; downgrades: 1.

Real edges that strengthened: pivot_s2_bounce / class_time_stop 1.28 -> 3.90 (Batch 415 fix landing - strategy_name now reaches class_time_stop correctly); vix_backwardation_long x 3 exits 0.80-1.71 -> 1.16-1.73; stoch_oversold / class_time_stop 1.60 -> 1.63 (n 6 -> 11 stable + slight gain = real edge).
PRODUCER_LAYER_ZERO_LIKELY unchanged at 6 - Batch 416 logging didn't surface the SMC root cause OR the logs haven't been inspected yet. Need to download engine logs from the cube AMI.
